entries.text: You see a dim glowing computer.
entries.source_text: You see a dim glowing computer.

entries.text: There is a trickle of power coming in. Most of the power seems to have been routed to maintain the few systems which are still semi-functioning.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: This computer is making a weird humming noise.
entries.source_text: This computer is making a weird humming noise.

entries.text: A monitor connected to this computer is printing the word 'System failure.' over and over.

entries.text: This computer appears to have been attacked by a ghoul.

entries.text: Lights are flashing on this computer but it seems random to you.

entries.text: This computer gives you a harmless shock when you touch it.
entries.source_text: This computer gives you a harmless shock when you touch it.

entries.text: Upon inspection you notice that this computer has been used as a home by rats.

entries.text: Random numbers are printing across a screen connected to this system.

entries.text: This computer is making the worst noise you have ever heard. The word 'Jared' is displayed on the monitor.
